blocks.text: **All three together:** 10.5 to 21 M tokens and 13 to 26 h of agent time.

blocks.title: The ranges on one scale
blocks.key: Key: each bar is a range; 1 column is 1 M tokens or 1 hour.

blocks.label: Basis
blocks.text: The engineer's check, from a past large task that the logbook measured: the clean-up of the hook's command rules took 8.1 M tokens and 11 h.

blocks.label: How sure
blocks.text: An estimate, not a measurement. The range is wide because review rounds vary.

blocks.label: What would change it
blocks.text: Each repair round adds a new review cycle: about 0.7 M tokens for one round of a small task (measured, the clean-up of leftover folders), more for a large one.

blocks.label: So far
blocks.text: Part 1 has used 1.0 M tokens (measured; the lead's own tokens come at its end).

blocks.label: Your time
blocks.text: Three reports to read and one update of sage. I have no measured basis for your time.

blocks.label: What I need from you
blocks.text: Nothing. If the cost is too high, tell me: parts 2 and 3 have not started.
